name: Aperture
description: Modern, minimal, gallery-grade theme for a photography portfolio — near-monochrome graphite on clean whites (Apple + Audi inspired) so imagery dominates, with a refined Apple-blue info and Audi-red error. Type: an elegant script display (Pinyon Script), an editorial serif heading (Playfair Display), and a clean, slightly elegant sans body (Manrope). Apply class="a1-theme-aperture" to <html>.
